productIntent.goal: AI-native, modular, industry-agnostic Enterprise Operating System where enterprise activity can be executed, explained, replayed, upgraded, and continuously evolved.

currentStage.name: Accounting Recognition / Trial Balance / GL Replay
currentStage.businessGoal: Make General Ledger results explainable, independently balanced and replayable from canonical BusinessData.

activeRequirementSet.name: Accounting Recognition + Rule Execution Trace + Trial Balance + GL Replay
acceptance: all published AccountingRules for one BusinessData are evaluated before journal commit
matched and non-matched rule conditions retain explicit trace
all matched rule effects aggregate into one Accounting Plan
a missing debit/credit effect caused by a condition error rejects the whole Journal atomically
diagnostics identify matched/not-matched rules and generated effects before suspecting source data
Trial Balance independently recomputes debit and credit totals from authoritative JournalLines
Trial Balance debit total equals credit total
General Ledger replay deletes derived accounting state and rebuilds from canonical BusinessData + published accounting rules
GL replay does not rewrite BusinessData
GL replay reproduces identical Journal/Trial-Balance semantic digest
verified: FAI-01/02 AccountingBook / Chart of Accounts / Journal / JournalLine are merged
at least one debit and one credit are enforced

alignmentCadence.countingRule: Count merged bounded slices whose evidence level is DATABASE E2E VERIFIED or CERTIFIED.
alignmentCadence.triggerRule: Run formal alignment at the third slice or any mandatory event trigger, whichever comes first.

nextRequirementSelection.rule: Keep the packet focused on explainable accounting recognition, independent balance verification and deterministic GL replay. Financial statements remain blocked until this evidence is green.

findings: legacy Asloop/bookkeeping semantics include explicit debit/credit concepts
current EVO generic ledger uses signed quantity/amount and does not enforce balanced journals
financial accounting must be layered as an explicit General Ledger projection rather than forcing operational ledgers into debit/credit terminology
invariants: each General Ledger journal has at least one debit and one credit line
sum(debit) equals sum(credit) under pinned accounting precision
financial statements derive from authoritative accounting state and never rewrite canonical BusinessData
